ExtractAll is invoked by memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload and resolveMentionTargets. GenerateSnippet is used by webhooks. RenderHTML is used by RSS. The frontend consumes a separate ReactMarkdown stack and does not use this Go-side interface.

The interface is markdown.Service, which carries the comment "Service handles markdown metadata extraction." Goldmark is the concrete implementation, wrapped inside service and built in NewService. MarkdownRenderer is not behind an interface; it is an internal helper instantiated by service methods and exercised only in tests.

Concrete implementation: `markdown.service` (unexported). It wraps goldmark plus custom extensions. Construction: `v1.NewAPIV1Service` calls `markdown.NewService(WithTagExtension(), WithMentionExtension())` at server startup via `server.NewServer` at line 76. Tests build instances directly in `test_helper.go`, `rss_test.go`, and `fileserver_test.go`.
